global_media_selector.exclusion_rule: exclude only genuinely rejected/unpromoted drift assets or assets failing current continuity/QC; legacy filename text alone does not determine lifecycle

global_negative_prompt: no indoor rain without physical opening

shots.media_rule: inventory and use all eligible apartment/departure coverage; hero S3H01 is an anchor, not the only source
shots.prompt: Continue directly from the Scene 02 terminal state in the established Paris apartment. Claire, unchanged in identity, dark wavy hair and dark silk robe/peignoir, finishes securing and carrying the one approved essential while retaining her phone, then turns toward the apartment exit. Preserve furniture, window orientation, scale, palette, storm state and established screen axis exactly. Use existing approved Scene 03 departure stills/variations/GIF or matched-angle media as coverage before generating any missing articulated motion. Character action and cloth/hair micro-response lead; rain and glass reflections remain localized behind her. Camera locked.
dialogue: DANIEL: Take the phone. Leave everything else.

shots.media_rule: use all eligible apartment-threshold and hallway coverage, including non-hero states and valid matched-angle/GIF assets
shots.prompt: From the validated S3-01 terminal state, Claire reaches the established apartment door, operates the physically correct handle and opens the same door into the same Parisian corridor. Door frame, hinges, hallway vanishing point, scale and screen direction remain fixed. Access indicators and corridor practicals change locally in synchronized sequence; relay clicks answer farther down the hall. A charcoal outer layer may appear only if shown as a motivated on-screen action. Use existing approved threshold/hallway media as motivated cut coverage wherever possible. No floating interface, no global flash, no door or hand deformation. Camera locked.
shots.terminal_policy: door geometry/Claire identity/hallway topology QC before chaining

shots.media_rule: use all eligible hallway coverage across multiple visual moments; do not hold one hero for the whole beat
shots.prompt: Build a deliberate hallway sequence from the complete approved Scene 03 hallway media pool. Claire remains the human anchor moving in one consistent direction. One or two anonymous residents may cautiously appear at their own doors, subordinate in scale and identity. Separate access indicators, locks and practicals answer in an ordered sequence down the stable corridor. Use motivated cuts between compatible source states, localized material/indicator FX and restrained depth separation. Do not simulate walking with pan/zoom and do not oscillate A/B framings.

shots.media_rule: use all eligible elevator-entry/interior/control coverage; hero S3H04 is only the topology/identity anchor
shots.prompt: Assemble the elevator passage from all approved Scene 03 elevator media. Preserve an ordinary physical elevator, panel housing, typography, reflective materials, Claire identity, phone and essential. The system selects the ground/lobby route before or as Claire approaches the controls. Animate only registered indicator/button states, localized cyan spill, reflections and Claire micro-balance/breath. Convey elevator motion through local character/material response and sound, never whole-frame wobble. Use motivated coverage changes from the broader media pool rather than a single repeated card.

shots.media_rule: use all eligible lobby/access-system coverage across multiple shots/states; do not reduce to one lobby hero
shots.prompt: Build the lobby handoff using the entire valid lobby media pool. The interior remains dry; rain is visible only beyond entrance glass. Preserve ordinary lobby architecture, elevator relationship, access hardware and the already-established transition motif. Animate elevator doors, locks, turnstile/door states, terminal status, local practicals and physically registered reflections in coordinated sequence. Claire recognizes that the building itself is participating. No invented emblem, no floating UI, no spectacle. Use the strongest compatible non-hero and hero media as real coverage.

shots.media_rule: use all eligible street/metro/escape coverage and valid Paris depth plates; hero S3H06 anchors geography only
shots.prompt: Open the scene into the rainy Paris street using the full approved street and transit media pool. Keep Claire foreground and continuous in identity/silhouette. Traffic signals synchronize, limited vehicles slow and change flow, transit displays reroute and a corridor clears calmly without panic or collision. Separate true foreground, midground and background layers from approved media and apply restrained 2.5D parallax only. Rain, haze, signals, vehicle motion and wet reflections provide most movement. No global zoom or shake and no geometry invention behind occluded regions.

shots.media_rule: use all eligible public-display/security/Paris reflection coverage; hero S3H07 anchors Claire and street geography only
shots.prompt: Create public proof from the full valid Scene 03 civic/transit/security media pool. Claire remains restrained in profile or over-shoulder. An ordinary municipal/transit display shows the same prepared transition status already established; nearby security personnel remain small, calm and procedural while one barrier or traffic movement is redirected. UI stays inside physical screen housings and screen light spills only locally. Keep continuous rain and reflections. No tanks, riot imagery, screaming crowd or propaganda tableau.

shots.media_rule: use all eligible Paris-night/forward-motion coverage and destination states; do not fake the walk with one hero zoom
shots.prompt: From the validated public-proof state, Claire moves purposefully away from the building and into reorganized Paris, retaining the same phone, approved essential, identity, anatomy, wardrobe continuity and screen direction. Use the complete approved Scene 03 Paris-night media pool as source-derived coverage and destination states. Prefer true bounded articulated walking continuation only where existing media cannot communicate the action. Cloth and hair respond subtly to the same storm field; rain, wet reflections and limited coordinated traffic continue around her. Camera observes from a locked or explicitly bounded position. End on forward motion and an unresolved city, not a static reveal.
shots.terminal_policy: must pass identity, anatomy, wardrobe, prop, geography, lighting, weather and temporal-motion QC before Scene 04 reuse
